topic: Scientific Models and States of Matter
key_concepts: Scientists use models to explain phenomena that cannot be easily seen or detected.
Scientific models are representations of objects, systems, or events.
Models help visualize, communicate ideas, understand processes, and make predictions.
Models can represent objects too small, too big, no longer existing, or not yet invented.
Models can represent events too slow, too fast, or yet to happen, and relationships.
Scientific models have limitations in details, approximations, and accuracy.
